Megalights：虚幻引擎5中的随机直接光照技术

Advances in Real-Time Rendering in Games, SIGGRAPH 2025 - Celebrating 20 years!

UE技术交流群：1073882251

1. 演讲者介绍

  • Kristoff Narovich：Epic Games 图形工程 Fellow，Lumen 联合创始人，负责光照系统
  • Thiago Costa：Epic Games 首席渲染程序员，负责光线追踪及其他渲染特性
  • 曾就职于 Rockstar North、Apple、Meta Reality Labs

我是 Kristoff，与 Thiago Costa 一起为大家介绍我们在虚幻引擎5中的新随机直接光照技术。本次演讲会保持较高层次的概述，但稍后你可以在发布的幻灯片中找到所有细节。

Hi, my name is Kristoff and together with Thiago Costa would like to present our new stochastic direct lighting technique in Unreal Engine 5. We're going to keep this somewhat high level, but later you'll be able to find all the details inside published slides.

2. 游戏对光照的需求

  • 游戏不断追求更高质量：更多光源、全动态投影、面光源柔和阴影
  • 复杂 BRDF 和材质分层使得无阴影光照计算变得昂贵
  • 工作流程成为游戏图形的主要限制因素
  • 目标：成为基准光照方法，至少在主机和中端 PC 上可用

游戏不断追求更高的质量标准。他们想要使用更多光源，希望所有光源都是完全动态且能投射阴影的，想要使用带有漂亮柔和阴影的面光源。他们还想使用更复杂的 BRDF 材质分层，这使得仅仅是无阴影光照计算就可能变得过于昂贵。

Games constantly want to push the quality bar. They want to use more lights. They want all lights to be fully dynamic and shadow casting. They want to use aerial lights with nice soft shadows. And they also want to use more complex BRDF material layering where basically just unshadowed light evaluation can become too expensive.

此外，游戏变得越来越复杂。我认为我们现在已经到了工作流程成为游戏图形主要限制因素的地步。理想情况下，美术应该能够自由创作而不受太多限制，就像这张截图一样——虽然可能有点过度，但这就是他们弄清楚如何程序化放置光源后发生的事情。

Also, games are becoming more complex. I think we are now at the point where actually workflows are the main limiting factor of game graphics. Ideally, artist should be able to work playfully without menu limitations, just like on this screenshot here, which is maybe a bit too excessive, but well, this is what happened when they figured out how to procedurally place lights.

我们还希望这成为我们的基准光照方法，让制作团队可以将其作为目标，而不是作为需要专门依赖的额外方法。因此，它必须至少能在主机和中端 PC 上运行。

We also want this to be our baseline lighting method, something where the production can target instead of being this extra method which they have specifically relied for. So, this has to work at least on consoles and mid-range PCs.

3. 传统直接光照方法

  • 前向/延迟光照：为每个光源预计算阴影贴图或光追阴影，然后乘以预积分光照辐照度
  • 对少量光源效果很好，但光源数量增加时成本过高
  • 离线渲染方法：追踪固定数量的光线，命中光源则累积能量
  • 固定光线数量的方法扩展性好，工作量恒定

在游戏中处理直接光照有很多方法。我们通常使用前向或延迟光照，首先为每个光源预计算阴影贴图，或者光线追踪阴影、降噪并预计算阴影遮罩，然后将这个阴影项乘以预积分的光照辐照度。这对于少量光源效果很好，但随着光源数量增加，成本会变得过高。

There are many ways how we can approach direct lighting in games. We usually use forward or deferred lighting where first for each light we precompute a shadow map or maybe we ray trace shadows, denoise them and precompute a shadow mask. And then we multiply this shadow term by the pre-integrated light irradiance. And this works pretty well for a small number of light sources. But as the number of lights increases, this can get too expensive.

另一种在离线渲染中更常见的方法是追踪固定数量的光线，比如基于 BRDF 或朝向某些光源子集，如果光线命中光源，我们就累积该能量。这种方法扩展性很好，因为无论场景中有多少光源，我们始终只做这固定数量的工作。

Another approach which is more common in offline rendering is to trace a fixed number of rays, let's say based on the BRDF or maybe towards some subset of lights and if the ray hits the light then we accumulate that energy and this scales really well because now no matter how many light sources are there in the scene we are always doing this fixed amount of work.

4. 延迟光照的扩展性问题

  • 延迟光照在游戏中非常流行，但无法扩展到所需的光照复杂度
  • 示例：一个像素在50个光源的衰减范围内，但只有15个实际可见，80%能量来自一个光源
  • 大量计算被浪费在被遮挡的光源上
  • BRDF 采样方法将问题转化为 GI 问题，但难以找到小或远的发光表面

鉴于延迟光照在游戏中如此流行，这也是我们开始研究的地方。我们尝试了许多不同的技术，但没有一个能扩展到我们期望的光照复杂度。当我们仔细审视内容时，原因显而易见。例如，如果我们看这个像素，它在50个光源的衰减范围内，所以我们必须预计算50张阴影贴图。但实际上只有15个光源可见，我们做了大量无用功。即使看那些可见的光源，80%的能量也只来自一个光源。那我们为什么还要尝试计算所有50个光源呢？只需以完整质量计算这一个光源，对其余的做某种近似就足够了。

Now given how popular deferred lighting is in games and this is where we started our investigation. We tried a bunch of different techniques, but nothing really could scale to our desired lighting complexity. And when we carefully looked at our content, it was obvious why. So, for example, if we look at this pixel here, it's in attenuation range of 50 lights. So, we have to precompute 50 shadow maps. But only 15 lights are actually visible. So, we just did a lot of wasted work. And even if we look at those visible lights, 80% of the energy is just coming from one light. So why are we even trying to compute all those 50 lights? It's really enough just to compute this one light at full quality and do some kind of approximation for the rest.

另一种方法是 BRDF 采样，基本上是把它变成一个 GI 问题。这是一种相当常见的方法。在虚幻引擎中，这是一种相当常见的变通方案——美术会使用某种发光网格，把它们从主视图中隐藏，然后本质上将它们用作柔和的面光源。这是免费的，因为无论如何我们都要计算 GI，但它有一定的质量问题。当我们进行 BRDF 采样时，即使有来自 GI 的额外引导，仍然很难找到那些发光表面，特别是如果它们非常小或者很远的话。

The other approach is BRDF sampling which is basically let's make it a GI problem. It's a pretty common approach. It's a pretty common workaround in Unreal Engine where artists take some kind of emissive meshes, they hide them from the main view and they essentially use them as soft aerial light sources. It's free because anyway we have to compute the GI but it has certain quality issues. When we are doing this BRDF sampling even with some additional guiding from the GI it's still really hard to find those emissive surfaces especially if they are very small or maybe they are far away.

5. 随机光照采样方法

  • GI 本身已经很难，在主机上60Hz运行的 GI 上再增加问题不现实
  • 新方法：随机追踪固定数量光线到随机选择的光源子集
  • 命中光源则累积能量到单个渲染目标，完成后降噪
  • 扩展性好：无论多少光源，工作量恒定
  • 关键挑战：主机上每像素只能追踪约一条光线，光源选择极其关键

另一个问题是 GI 本身就很难。即使在离线渲染中，也常用技巧比如在窗户内放置光源让 GI 更快收敛。但这里我们有一个必须在主机上以60Hz运行的 GI，我们还要在它上面增加额外的问题。第三种方法是构建一个新系统，我们随机追踪固定数量的光线到随机选择的光源子集。如果光线命中光源，我们就将该能量累积到单个渲染目标中。所有追踪完成后，我们对这个渲染目标进行降噪。这种方法扩展性很好，因为无论场景中有多少光源，我们始终只做这固定数量的工作。

And another problem is that GI is already hard. Even in offline rendering, it's common to use tricks like placing lights inside windows so that GI can converge faster. But here we have this GI which has to work on consoles at 60 Hz and we are adding an extra problem on top of it. The third approach would be to build a new system where we stochastically trace a fixed number of rays towards some stochastically selected subset of lights. And if a ray hits a light, then we accumulate that energy into a single render target. And after all tracing is done, we are going to denoise this render target. And this scales really well because no matter how many lights are there in the scene, we are always doing this fixed amount of work.

显然在实践中事情没那么简单。在主机上我们可能每像素只能追踪一条光线，这意味着光源选择在这里极其关键。如果我们看这个图表，我们只追踪两条光线到两个光源。它们看起来很重要因为它们很近，但结果是所有这些光源都被遮挡了，我们浪费了整个追踪预算却什么都没计算出来。

Now obviously in practice things aren't that simple on a console we can maybe do like one ray per pixel which means that the light selection is extremely critical here. If we take a look at this diagram here we just trace two rays towards two lights. They seem to be really important because they are really close but turns out that all those lights are occluded and we just wasted our entire tracing budget and we didn't really compute anything.

6. 光源选择方法与 ReSTIR 分析

  • 光源层次结构方法：将光源放入层次结构，找最有趣的簇，但不考虑阴影项
  • ReSTIR：在高端 PC GPU 上效果惊人，但能否缩减到主机？
  • ReSTIR 工作原理：从历史或邻域获取样本，追踪检查可见性，与随机选择的候选光源结合
  • 质量很好但有很高的固定成本，主要是额外追踪的成本

有几种不同的光源选择方法。一种相当流行的是光源层次结构，首先我们把所有光源放入某种层次结构，然后尝试找到最有趣的簇。但它们都有同样的问题——不考虑阴影项，而正如我们所见，阴影项非常重要。另一种非常流行的方法是 ReSTIR。我想每个人都看到了它在高端 PC GPU 上能产生多么惊人的效果。但问题是它能缩减吗？它能成为我们的基准光照方法吗？

There are a few different ways how we can approach light selection. A pretty popular one are light hierarchies where first we put all our lights into some kind of hierarchy and then we try to find the most interesting cluster and they all have the same problem. They don't account for the shadowing term which as we can see here is really important. The other very popular approach is ReSTIR. I think everyone saw how amazing stuff it can ship on the high-end PC GPU. But the question is can it scale down? Can it become this our baseline lighting method?

为了回答这个问题，我们需要看看 ReSTIR 做了什么。它会在我们之前的管线中注入三个橙色块。这些块首先尝试从历史或邻域获取一些样本，然后我们追踪光线来检查这些复用样本的可见性，最后我们将复用样本与随机选择的光源候选结合。基本思想是，如果这一帧我们选择了一些很差的候选——比如所有选中的光源都被遮挡——那么很可能我们能在历史中找到更好的，或者我们的邻居更幸运。这在质量方面效果很好，但也增加了很高的固定成本。不仅是复用操作的成本，更重要的是那些额外追踪的成本，因为现在我们需要检查每个复用样本的可见性。

And in order to answer this question we actually need to take a look at what ReSTIR does. So it would inject those three orange blocks into our previous pipeline. And those blocks will first try to grab some samples from the history or maybe from the neighborhood. Then we are going to trace array in order to check the visibility of those reused samples. And finally we are going to combine reuse samples together with a stochastically selected light candidates. And the general idea here if this frame we select some really bad candidates let's say all our selected lights are occluded then most likely we can find something better in the history or maybe our neighbors were more lucky. And this works really well for the quality side but it also adds a very high constant cost. And it's not only the cost of reuse operation but most importantly it's the cost of those extra traces because now we need to check the visibility of each reused sample.

7. ReSTIR 在主机上的局限性

关键点:

  • ReSTIR 至少需要每像素一个样本，这意味着每像素需要追踪2-3条光线
  • 主机上每像素只能追踪约一条光线
  • 候选采样需要按 BRDF 加权，并检查至少 20% 的光源列表
  • 在主机上这非常昂贵，因为需要对 20% 的光源进行无阴影光照计算
  • 强遮挡光源会使问题更严重，因为按 BRDF 加权会导致大量采样指向被遮挡的光源

ReSTIR 至少需要每像素一个样本，这意味着每像素需要追踪两到三条光线。但在主机上我们可能只能每像素追踪一条光线。另一个问题是候选采样。理论上我们可以从列表中随机选择一个光源就完事了。但实际上要获得合理的质量，我们需要非常谨慎地选择光源。我们需要按 BRDF 加权每个光源，并且需要检查至少 20% 的光源列表。这在高端 PC GPU 上可能不是大问题，但在主机上会变得非常昂贵，因为我们实际上是在对场景中 20% 的光源进行无阴影光照计算。

We need to do at least one sample per pixel which would require tracing two or three rays per pixel here. But on the console we can do maybe one trace per pixel. The other problem is candidate sampling. So in theory we could just grab a random light from the list and be done. But in practice to get a reasonable quality we need to be really careful with our light selection. We need to weight each light by the BRDF and we need to check at least 20% of the light list. And this is maybe not a big deal on a high-end PC GPU, but on a console it can get really expensive because basically what we are doing here, we are doing unshadowed light evaluation for 20% of lights in our scene.

当有强遮挡光源时问题更严重，因为我们按 BRDF 加权每个光源，会追踪大量候选样本到这些光源，使得更难找到可见的高质量候选样本。所以基本上 ReSTIR 已经超出了我们的预算，我们仍然需要解决一个非常类似的光源采样问题。一个好问题是：有没有比 ReSTIR 更好的方法？当我们尝试随机光源采样时，我们注意到有时简单的采样（没有任何复用）看起来比 ReSTIR 更好，这有一个很好的解释。ReSTIR 从历史中复用好的离散样本，但这会导致样本相关性。

And it's even more problematic when we have strong occluded lights because we weight each light by the BRDF. We are going to trace a bunch of those candidate samples towards those lights making it even harder to find those visible high-quality candidate samples. So basically ReSTIR is already outside of our budget and we kind of still need to solve a very similar light sampling problem as before. So a good question is: is there something that we can do better than ReSTIR? And when we were playing with stochastic light sampling we notice that sometimes simple sampling without any kind of reuse looks better than ReSTIR and there is a very good explanation for that. So what ReSTIR does is it reuses good discrete samples from the history but this causes sample correlation.

8. 可见光源列表方法

关键点:

  • ReSTIR 的样本复用会导致样本相关性，输出中出现难以降噪的样本团块
  • 理想方案：每像素维护一个可见光源列表，每帧可以选择不同光源生成易于降噪的交错模式
  • 必须是可见光源列表，不想追踪被遮挡的光源
  • 上一帧可见的样本很可能这一帧也可见，可以用历史来构建可见光源列表
  • 无法为每像素构建光源列表（数据量太大），但可以为 8x8 屏幕空间 tile 构建

这会导致样本相关性。基本上在输出中我们得到这些样本团块，它们非常难以降噪。理想情况下，我们希望每像素有一个可见光源列表，这样每帧我们可以从列表中选择不同的光源，生成那些非常容易降噪的漂亮交错模式。而且这必须是可见光源列表。我们不想追踪被遮挡的光源。它们对最终像素没有真正贡献。上一帧可见的样本很可能这一帧也可见。所以我们可以用历史来构建这个可见光源列表。

This causes sample correlation. Basically on the output we get those clumps of samples which are really hard to denoise. Ideally, what we would have here is that we would have a visible light list per pixel so that each frame we can select a different light from the list and generate those nice interleaved patterns which are really easy to denoise and this has to be a visible light list. We don't want to be tracing towards occluded lights. They don't really contribute towards final pixels. And likely samples which were visible last frame will be also visible this frame. So we can use history to build this visible light list.

现在我们不能为每像素构建光源列表。那会是太多数据。但我们可以为比如说 8x8 屏幕空间 tile 构建。现在当我们有了这个光源列表，在采样时我们可以把像素重投影到前一帧，从那个列表中选择一个光源。那些 8x8 屏幕空间 tile 相当大。所以我们可能会在它们之间有一些不连续性，因为本质上我们是在从一个光源列表急剧切换到另一个。为了隐藏这些，我们使用随机双线性查找。显然我们不能只采样可见光源列表。场景是动态的，之前隐藏的光源现在可能变得可见。

Now we cannot build a light list per pixel. That would be just too much data. But we could have it for let's say 8x8 screen space tile. And now when we have this light list during sampling we can take our pixel, reproject it into the previous frame and pick a light from that list. Those 8x8 screen space tiles are pretty big. So we may have some kind of discontinuities between them as essentially we are sharply switching from one light list into another. In order to hide those we use a stochastic bilinear lookup. And obviously we can't just sample the visible light list. The scenes are dynamic and lights which were hidden now may become visible.

9. 隐藏光源发现与管线更新

关键点:

  • 分配 20% 样本用于检查隐藏光源，分别采样隐藏和可见光源列表
  • 将隐藏光源样本权重限制在总权重的 20%，即使有强遮挡光源也不会发送超过 20% 的样本
  • 历史重投影失败时使用最近的可见光源列表，但将隐藏光源比例提高到 50%
  • 新管线增加了一个负责为每个 8x8 屏幕空间 tile 构建可见光源列表的模块

所以我们这样做：分配 20% 的样本用于检查隐藏光源。这可以通过分别采样隐藏光源列表和可见光源列表来简单实现。在合并它们之前，我们可以将隐藏光源样本的权重限制在总权重的 20%。这比降低隐藏光源权重的方法效果好得多。现在我们可以保证，即使有一个非常强的被遮挡光源，我们也不会发送超过 20% 的样本到它那里。

So what we do here is that we allocate 20% of our samples towards checking hidden lights. And this can be pretty simply implemented by separately sampling hidden light list and separately sampling visible light list. And just before we merge them, we can clamp the weight of the hidden light sample to the 20% of the total. And this works much better than for example down-weighting the hidden lights. As now we can guarantee that even if we have this very strong occluded light, we won't ever send more than 20% of samples towards it.

如果历史重投影失败，例如重投影后超出屏幕范围或深度测试失败，我们仍然想使用最近的可见光源列表，因为它很可能包含一些好的光源。但我们会将隐藏光源比例提高到 50%。这样我们可以加速可见光源的发现。现在当我们有了这个可见光源列表，我们可以看看新的管线。它看起来和之前很相似，但现在有了这个新的橙色块。这个块负责为每个 8x8 屏幕空间 tile 构建可见光源列表。之后我们可以用这个列表来引导我们的样本。构建列表非常便宜。大多数追踪都贡献给最终像素。我们还有这个光源列表可以用来生成降噪器的漂亮模式。

And if the history reprojection fails, for example, after reprojection will be out of screen bounds or maybe the depth test will fail, we still want to use our closest visible light list as it most likely contains some good lights. But we are going to increase the hidden light fraction to 50%. So this way we can speed up the visible light discovery. And now when we have this visible light list, we can take a look at our new pipeline. It looks pretty similar to what we saw before, but now we have this new orange block. This block is responsible for building the visible light list per 8x8 screen space tile. And later we can use this list in order to guide our samples. Building the list is pretty cheap. Most of our traces contribute towards the final pixels. And also we have this light list which we can use now to generate those nice patterns for the denoiser.

10. 加权蓄水池采样与蓝噪声

关键点:

  • 使用加权蓄水池采样选择样本，可以遍历所有光源一次并随机选择一个
  • 按 BRDF 的亮度加权每个光源，并应用对数进行感知加权
  • 使用时空蓝噪声（STBN）生成优化降噪的漂亮模式
  • STBN 每像素只预计算一个随机变量，但可以通过样本扭曲多次复用
  • 每次光源选择循环迭代后，将选定范围扭曲回 0-1；多光线时使用分层采样

为了选择样本，我们使用加权蓄水池采样。你可以在底部看到它。这是一个非常简单的算法，允许我们遍历所有光源一次，并根据权重随机选择一个。我们按 BRDF 的亮度加权每个光源，还应用对数进行感知加权。这里的想法是，例如如果我们有一个非常强的光源，经过色调映射后它不会对最终像素产生那么大的影响。对于那些优化降噪的漂亮模式，我们将使用时空蓝噪声。

In order to select our samples, we use weighted reservoir sampling. You can see it here at the bottom. It's a very simple algorithm which allows us to loop over all lights once and stochastically select one based on their weight. We weight each light by luminance of a BRDF and we also apply a logarithm for perceptual weighting. The idea here is for example if we have a very very strong light then after tone mapping it won't really affect the final pixels as much and for those nice patterns optimized for denoising we are going to use spatial temporal blue noise.

现在有一个问题。STBN 每像素只预计算一个随机变量。但如你所见，我们实际上需要一堆随机变量才能每像素选择一个光源。幸好有一些方法可以让我们多次复用这个随机变量，同时仍然保持那些漂亮的 STBN 噪声属性。为了每像素选择一个样本，在每次光源选择循环迭代后，我们可以将选定范围扭曲回 0-1。如果你想每像素追踪多条光线，我们可以使用分层采样，本质上就是将我们的随机变量重映射到多个段。

Now there's one problem. So STBN precalculates a single random variable per pixel. But as you can see here at the bottom, we actually need a bunch of those random variables just to select one light per pixel. Thankfully, there are some ways which can allow us to reuse this random variable multiple times while still preserving those nice STBN noise properties. In order to pick one sample per pixel after each light selection loop iteration, we can warp the selected range back to 0-1. And if you want to trace multiple rays per pixel, then we can use stratified sampling, which essentially will just remap our random variable into multiple segments.

11. 实际场景中的光源采样优化

关键点:

  • 所有这些允许我们只用一个随机变量采样所有光源，同时保持 STBN 噪声属性
  • 实际场景中不能遍历光源网格单元中的所有光源（可能有数百个）
  • 检查可见光源列表上的所有光源，并检查光源网格单元中的一些光源（每像素检查不同子集）
  • 按 BRDF 亮度加权可以标量化计算节省 VGPR
  • 丢弃低于阈值的样本以提高质量

所有这些允许我们只用一个随机变量采样所有光源。但最重要的是我们设法保持了那些漂亮的 STBN 噪声属性。所以我们基本上免费获得了这个非常好的质量提升。我们不做任何额外计算。我们不追踪任何额外光线。现在我们知道如何选择光源了。但在实际场景中，我们不能真的遍历光源网格单元中的所有光源。可能有数百个。所以我们改为检查可见光源列表上的所有光源。它们很可能仍然可见。我们还检查光源网格单元中的一些光源，每个像素检查不同的子集。这相当不连贯，对性能不太好，但它允许我们非常快速地发现新的可见光源。

And all of this allows us to sample all the lights using just a single random variable. But the most important part here is that we manage to maintain those nice STBN noise properties. So we get this really nice quality increase essentially for free. We don't really do any extra computations. We don't trace any extra rays. Now we know how to select the light. But in a real scene, we cannot be really looping over all lights inside the light grid cell. There may be like hundreds of those. So what we do instead is that we check all the lights on the visible light list. Most likely they will be still visible. And we check some lights from the light grid cell where each pixel checks a different subset. This is pretty incoherent and not great for performance, but it allows us very quickly to discover new visible lights.

我们这里做的另一个小优化是，因为我们按 BRDF 的亮度加权每个光源，我们不需要计算完整的 RGB。我们可以标量化我们的计算并节省一些 VGPR。我们还丢弃低于某个阈值的样本。这不是性能优化，但它有助于质量。这里的想法是，如果一个光源不够强，不足以影响最终像素，那么检查它的可见性就没有意义。相反，我们应该把这条光线用于更重要的事情。

Another small optimization which we do here is because we weight each light by luminance of a BRDF, we don't really need to compute the full RGB. We can just scalarize our computations and save some VGPRs. And we also drop samples below a certain threshold. This is not really a performance optimization, but it helps with quality. The idea here is if we have a light which isn't really strong enough to affect the final pixel, then there's no really point to check its visibility. Instead, we should use this ray for something more important.

12. 低分辨率采样与方向光处理

关键点:

  • 光源权重在相似深度和法线的像素之间通常相似，可以低分辨率采样
  • 使用棋盘格或叉形模式，在空间和时间上抖动以最大化重建机会
  • 使用随机双线性上采样重建，无法重建时复用历史（无邻域钳制）
  • 这种技术可能使阴影变软，但采样速度提高四倍
  • 方向光通常比局部光强数千倍，限制方向光样本为预算的 50%

光源权重在像素之间通常相当相似，至少在深度和法线相似时是这样。所以我们可以利用这一点在较低分辨率下采样。例如，不是每像素选择一个光源，我们可以每四个像素选择四个光源。重要的是我们需要非常小心我们的采样模式。我们使用棋盘格或叉形模式，并在空间和时间上抖动这些模式。这样我们可以最大化能够重建某些东西的机会。对于实际重建，我们使用带有深度和法线加权的随机双线性上采样。如果这一帧我们无法重建某些东西，我们就直接复用历史，不做任何历史修正。没有邻域钳制或类似的东西。总的来说，这种技术有时会使阴影变软，但它也将采样速度提高了四倍。所以通常这是一个很好的权衡。

Light weights are usually pretty similar between pixels, at least if depths and normals are similar. So we can use this in order to sample at a lower resolution. For example, instead of selecting one light per pixel, we could be selecting four lights every four pixels. The important thing is that we need to be really careful with our sampling patterns. We use either checkerboarding or forks pattern and we jitter those patterns both in space and in time. This way we can maximize our chances to be able to reconstruct something. For the actual reconstruction we use stochastic bilinear upsampling with some depth and normal weighting. And if we cannot reconstruct something this frame then we are just going to reuse history without any kind of history rectification. So, no neighborhood clamp or anything like that. And overall, this technique sometimes can make our shadows softer, but it also speeds up sampling four times. So, usually it's a great trade-off in practice.

使用随机采样时，方向光可能相当棘手，因为我们按 BRDF 加权每个光源，而方向光通常比任何局部光强数千倍。所以我们可能最终只是把所有光线都追踪到方向光。一个相当流行的解决方案是把方向光从随机光源采样中移除，比如在单独的光线追踪阴影 pass 中运行它们。但这也相当昂贵，因为现在我们需要每像素追踪这条额外的光线，还需要另一个降噪 pass。所以我们这里做的是将方向光样本限制在预算的 50%，当局部光变暗或没有局部光时放宽这个限制。基本上在那种情况下我们仍然想把所有追踪发送到方向光。

Directional lights can be pretty tricky when using stochastic sampling because we weight each light by the BRDF and directional lights are usually thousands times stronger than any local lights. So we essentially may end up just tracing all rays towards the directional light. A pretty popular solution is just to remove directional lights from the stochastic light sampling and let's say run them in a separate ray tracing shadow pass. But it's also pretty expensive because now we need to trace this extra ray per pixel and we need another denoising pass. So what we do here instead is that we limit directional light samples to 50% of our budget and we are going to relax this limit as the local lights are dim or maybe there are no local lights at all. Basically in that case we still want to send all the traces towards the directional light.

13. 面光源处理与着色

关键点:

  • 面光源可能很大，二元可见性不够，需要 2x2 位掩码追踪每个光源的可见部分
  • 采样时先选择光源，再选择光源上的点，降低隐藏部分的权重
  • 使用 STBN 和样本扭曲处理 2D 点
  • 着色时累积所有可见样本权重，乘以预积分光照辐照度
  • 假设可以分离着色和阴影，允许减少噪声并保持向后兼容性

另一件我们需要看的是面光源。它们可能相当大，仅仅二元可见性是不够的。例如，如果我们看这张截图，光源的大部分被遮挡了，我们可能最终只是追踪一堆光线到被遮挡的部分，浪费我们的预算。所以我们这里做的是有一个特殊的 2x2 位掩码来追踪每个光源的可见部分。这个位掩码和可见光源列表一起构建。当我们采样光源时，首先我们每像素选择一个光源，然后对于每个光源我们需要选择光源上的一个特定点。在这个选择过程中，我们将降低光源隐藏部分的权重。这样我们可以发送更多光线到可见部分，减少噪声。

Another thing we need to take a look at here are area lights. Those may be pretty big and just binary visibility isn't really enough. For example, if we take a look at this screenshot here, a large part of the light is occluded and we may end up just tracing a bunch of rays towards the occluded part, wasting our budget. So what we do here is that we have a special 2x2 bit mask which tracks visible parts of each light. And this bit mask is just built together with the visible light list. And when we are sampling our lights, first we select one light per pixel and then for each light we need to select a specific point on the light source. And during this selection we are going to downweight the hidden parts of the light. This way we can send more rays towards the visible parts reducing noise.

和之前一样，我们将使用 STBN 和样本扭曲。只是稍微不同的风格，因为现在我们处理的是 2D 点。现在我们准备好着色我们的样本了。首先我们将累积所有影响给定像素的可见样本权重，然后我们将这个累积权重乘以预积分光照辐照度。这确实走了一些捷径，因为预积分光照辐照度假设我们可以分离着色和阴影。但它允许我们减少一些噪声，最重要的是它实现了向后兼容性，因为现在随机光源看起来和非随机的完全一样。这不是一个根本限制，只是我们在这里做的某种权衡。

And as before, we are going to use STBN with sample warping. Just a bit different flavor of those as now we're dealing with 2D points. And now we are ready to shade our samples. So first we are going to accumulate all the visible sample weights which affect given pixel and then we are going to multiply this accumulated weight by the pre-integrated light irradiance. This does cut some corners as basically pre-integrated light irradiance assumes that we can separate shading from shadowing. But it allows us to remove a bit of noise and most importantly it enables backwards compatibility as now stochastic lights will look exactly the same as non-stochastic ones. It's not really a fundamental limitation just a certain trade-off which we made here.

14. 降噪处理

关键点:

  • 着色后进行降噪，仅靠 TSR 效果不错但某些部分需要专门降噪
  • 所有光源使用单个降噪 pass，分别处理漫反射和高光信号
  • 信号被解调以移除非随机材质属性（如纹理 albedo）
  • 基于 SVGF 引入的时间方差跟踪
  • 时间滤波器重投影历史、累积光照和光照矩（存储漫反射和高光亮度的一阶和二阶矩）

着色后我们将进行降噪。仅靠 TSR 效果已经很不错了，但确实有一些部分需要专门的降噪。我们对所有光源使用单个降噪 pass，它分别处理漫反射和高光信号。这两个信号都被解调，意味着我们移除非随机材质属性。我们不想模糊像纹理 albedo 这样的东西。降噪器的基本思想是基于 SVGF 引入的时间方差跟踪。这个时间方差告诉我们一个像素有多嘈杂。所以我们知道需要对它应用多少空间滤波器。

And after shading we'll be doing denoising. Already with just TSR things look pretty good but there are definitely some parts which would require dedicated denoising. We have a single denoising pass for all lights and it runs on separate diffuse and specular signals. Both of those signals are demodulated which means that we remove non-stochastic material properties. We don't want to be blurring things like for example texture albedo. And the general idea of a denoiser is based on tracking temporal variance which was introduced by SVGF. So this temporal variance gives us an idea how noisy is a pixel. So we know how much of a spatial filter we need to apply to it.

在时间滤波器方面，这是我们重投影历史、累积光照和光照矩的地方。我们用两个 32 位格式存储光照，这得益于随机浮点量化。我们还存储一阶和二阶矩，但只针对漫反射亮度和高光亮度。之后我们可以用这些矩来重建时间方差。我们运行邻域钳制。这是一个相当宽的 5x5 钳制。首先我们加载并打包所有内容到组共享内存，然后从这个组共享内存我们可以运行方差裁剪。我们这里做了两个有趣的技巧。第一个是我们将根据与邻域边界的距离来减少历史权重。这里的想法是，如果我们的新数据与历史相差很远，那么很可能我们应该快速丢弃这个历史以消除重影。另一件事是在下采样时，我们的一些像素将被重建。所以对于这些样本，我们将稍微放宽邻域钳制。

On the temporal filter side, this is where we reproject history, accumulate lighting and lighting moments. We store our lighting in two 32-bit formats which is possible thanks to stochastic float quantization. And we also store the first and second moments but only for the luminance of diffuse and luminance of specular. And later we can use those moments to reconstruct temporal variance. We run our neighborhood clamp. It's a pretty wide clamp of 5x5. So first we load and pack everything into group shared and then from this group shared we can run our variance clipping. The two interesting tricks which we do here. So the first one is that we are going to reduce the history weight based on the distance from the neighborhood bounds. The idea here is if our new data is really far away from the history then most likely we should discard this history really quickly in order to remove ghosting. And the other thing is when doing downsampling some of our pixels are going to be reconstructed. So for those samples we are going to relax our neighborhood clamp a bit.

15. 空间滤波器与降噪优化

关键点:

  • 空间滤波器不使用标准的多次 atrous pass（太昂贵），而是单 pass 稀疏核，每像素旋转
  • 仅在高相对方差的像素上应用核，既提高性能又使信号更锐利
  • 使用标准边缘停止函数避免模糊不相关材质
  • 在色调映射空间累积以去除萤火虫，随历史累积逐渐淡出色调映射和额外样本

空间滤波器与标准的有些不同。我们不运行那些标准的多次 atrous pass，因为在我们的用例中太昂贵了。相反，我们使用单个 pass 和单个稀疏核，每像素旋转。这与 TSR 配合得很好，TSR 可以清理它。我们只在相对方差较高的像素上应用这个核。这不仅提高了性能，还帮助我们使信号更锐利。然后我们使用标准的边缘停止函数。我们不想模糊一些不相关的材质。为了处理遮挡，我们在色调映射空间累积，这允许我们去除萤火虫。我们还增加空间样本数量。随着我们向历史累积更多数据，我们会逐渐淡出色调映射和那些额外样本。

Spatial filter is a bit different from standard ones. We don't run those multiple atrous passes because that's just too expensive in our use case. Instead, we have a single pass with a single sparse kernel which is rotated per pixel. And this works pretty well with TSR which can clean it up. And we only apply this kernel in pixels where we have a high relative variance. This not only improves performance but it also helps us to make the signal a bit sharper. Then we do the standard edge stopping functions. We don't want to be blurring some unrelated materials. And in order to handle this occlusion, we are accumulating in tone map space which allows us to remove fireflies. And we also increase the number of spatial samples. And as we accumulate more data into the history, we are going to fade out both the tone mapping and those extra samples.

16. 降噪与时间上采样的集成

关键点:

  • 降噪在渲染分辨率累积，时间上采样在显示分辨率累积（更高）
  • 降噪历史中的一个像素对应上采样后的多个像素
  • 混合不相关像素会导致模糊，每帧丢弃历史会导致噪声
  • 解决方案：利用可见光源列表计算像素可接收的总能量，与本帧成功采样的能量比较
  • 如果采样能量比例高（如80%来自一个光源），可以减少降噪或直接传给 TSR

降噪还有一个问题需要讨论。降噪在渲染分辨率累积，但时间上采样在显示分辨率累积，这要高得多。这意味着降噪历史中的一个像素实际上对应上采样后的一堆像素。所以在做降噪时我们有这个选择：要么混合那些不相关的像素，导致模糊的光照；要么每帧丢弃历史，基本上导致噪声。但正如我们之前看到的，通常大部分能量只来自一个或两个光源。比如说如果80%的能量来自一个光源，而我们这帧能够采样到那个光源，那么这个像素很可能不是很嘈杂，我们可以直接把它传给 TSR。我们有一个很好的启发式方法。可见光源列表给我们一个像素可以接收的总能量。我们也知道这帧成功采样了什么。现在基于采样能量的比例，我们可以减少降噪，或者有时我们可以直接把这个信号传给 TSR。这个启发式本身可能有点嘈杂。所以我们在上面应用一点时间稳定化。但总体效果很好。我不确定这里是否可见，但右边的图像清晰得多。现在我把话筒交给 Thiago。

There is one more issue with denoising which we have to discuss here. So denoiser accumulates in render resolution but the temporal upsampling accumulates in display resolution which is much higher. What it means is that one pixel in our denoiser's history corresponds actually to a bunch of pixels after upsampling. So when doing denoising we have this choice: either we blend those unrelated pixels which results in blurry lighting, or we have to discard history each frame which basically results in noise. But as we could see before, often a large part of the energy is just coming from one or maybe two lights. And let's say if 80% of the energy is coming from one light and we were able to sample that light this frame, then most likely this pixel isn't really noisy and we could just pass it directly to TSR. And we have a pretty good heuristic for that. The visible light list gives us a total amount of energy which a pixel can receive. And we also know what we successfully sampled this frame. And now based on this fraction of the sampled energy, we can either reduce denoising or sometimes we can just pass this signal directly to TSR. This heuristic itself may be a bit noisy. So we apply a bit of temporal stabilization on top. But overall it works pretty well. I'm not sure if it's visible here, but this image on the right is much much sharper. And now I'm going to hand it off to Thiago.

17. 硬件光线追踪与可见性计算

关键点:

  • 主要使用硬件光线追踪计算光源样本可见性，避免维护和渲染多个阴影贴图的开销
  • 不能以主视图渲染的细节级别在 BVH 中表示所有物体（内存开销高）
  • Nanite 游戏使用高细节网格，BVH 构建和追踪可能太昂贵
  • 使用简化代理网格、激进实例剔除和聚合表示来降低光线追踪复杂度
  • 近场（150米内）使用代理网格，远场使用更激进简化的表示存储在单独的 TLAS 中

大家好。现在让我们来看看我们如何实际计算光源样本的可见性。我们使用的主要方法是硬件光线追踪，这让我们可以避免每帧维护和渲染多个阴影贴图的开销，这在处理大量光源时尤其成问题。

Hi everyone. Let's now go over how we actually compute visibility for the light samples. The main method we use is hardware ray tracing, which allows us to avoid the overhead of maintaining and rendering multiple shadow maps per frame, which is especially problematic when dealing with large numbers of lights.

然而，虽然阴影质量在这里极其重要，但我们无法以用于渲染主视图的细节量在 BVH 中表示所有物体。首先，每顶点有很高的内存开销，在使用 Nanite 的虚幻游戏中，往往使用高度细节的网格，这意味着 BVH 构建和追踪可能变得太昂贵。此外，拼装环境会导致大量实例重叠，进一步增加追踪成本。所以我们需要使用简化的代理网格以及激进的实例剔除和聚合表示来降低光线追踪中关卡的复杂度。我们使用两种光线追踪表示。在近场（覆盖玩家相机周围150米区域），我们使用代理网格。这些是原始几何体的低多边形表示，在性能和精度之间提供良好平衡，非常适合近距离追踪。如果光线没有命中任何近场网格并延伸到其半径之外，我们还会对关卡的更激进简化表示进行追踪。在这个表示中，我们合并实例并显著减少三角形数量以降低光线遍历成本。远场表示存储在单独的 TLAS 中，这使得这些追踪更快，因为 BVH 复杂度要低得多，并且默认使用内联光线追踪，因为我们在当前一代主机上获得更好的性能。

However, while shadow quality is extremely important here, we can't represent all objects in BVHs with the amount of detail that is used to render the main view. These are lower polygon representations of the original geometry that provide a good balance between performance and accuracy and are ideal for close proximity tracing. If rays don't hit any near field mesh and extend outside its radius, we also trace against a more aggressively simplified representation of the level. And in this representation, we merge instances and significantly reduce triangle count to keep ray traversal cost down. The far field representation is stored in a separate TLAS which makes those traces faster since the BVH complexity is far lower and use inline ray tracing by default since we get better performance on the current generation of consoles.

18. 代理网格不匹配问题

关键点:

  • 代理网格与光栅化几何体之间的不匹配导致错误的软阴影
  • 从光栅几何体表面追踪的光线可能立即与代理网格三角形相交
  • 使用曲面细分、模拟布料网格等无法在光线追踪中有效表示的特性会出现问题
  • 动画和 Alpha 遮罩几何体在光线追踪中表示和追踪都很昂贵
  • 前面或背面剔除无法完全解决问题，且会增加约10%的追踪开销

使用代理网格进行光线追踪有一个主要缺点，就是代理几何体和光栅化几何体之间的不匹配。这些不匹配会导致错误的软阴影，因为光线是从光栅几何体表面追踪的，它们可能会立即与代理网格三角形相交。在这些截图中，我们可以看到玩家前面墙上的错误阴影，因为那个网格使用了我们无法在光线追踪中有效表示的曲面细分。

同样在地板上，有一些不匹配导致更多的自阴影。甚至在玩家角色上，有模拟的布料网格在光线追踪中没有很好地表示，导致错误的阴影。还有动画和 Alpha 遮罩几何体的常见问题，它们在光线追踪中表示和追踪光线都特别昂贵。不幸的是，这些不匹配问题无法通过简单地在光线上使用前面或背面剔除来避免。在左边的图表中，我们可以看到背面剔除足以防止错误的遮挡。然而，在右边，我们可以看到光线也命中了前面，在这种情况下会导致错误的阴影。

此外，我们发现使用前面或背面剔除会增加约10%的追踪开销，因为它阻止了光线遍历期间的一些提前退出。所以所有这些意味着我们不能仅仅依赖硬件光线追踪和代理网格，而是需要使用回退机制来解决这些问题。

Using proxy meshes for ray tracing has one major downside which is mismatches between the proxy geometry and the rasterized geometry. Those mismatches cause incorrect soft shadowing since the rays are traced from the raster geometry surface and they might immediately intersect with the proxy mesh triangles. In these screenshots, we can see incorrect shadowing on the wall in front of the player because that mesh uses tessellation that we can't efficiently represent in ray tracing. And similarly on the floor, there are mismatches that cause more self shadowing. And even on the player character, there's simulated cloth mesh that is not well represented in ray tracing and results in an incorrect shadow. There are also the usual issues with animated and alpha mask geometry which are especially expensive to represent in ray tracing and expensive to trace rays against. Unfortunately, these mismatch issues cannot be avoided by simply using front or back face culling on the rays. On the diagram on the left, we can see that back face culling is enough to prevent incorrect occlusion. However, on the right, we can see a situation where the ray also hits a front face and in this case, it would result in an incorrect shadow. On top of that, we have found that using either front or back face culling adds about 10% of overhead tracing since it prevents some early exits during the ray traversal. So all of this means that we cannot just rely on hardware ray trace and proxy meshes and instead we need to use fallback mechanisms to work around these issues.

19. 屏幕空间光线追踪

关键点:

  • 使用屏幕空间光线追踪避免错误的自阴影，因为光线是针对光栅几何体深度缓冲追踪的
  • 可以基于屏幕追踪的距离偏移世界追踪的原点，避免大多数自阴影问题
  • 额外好处：获得 BVH 中未表示细节的接触阴影
  • 不同于典型接触阴影，需要像素精确的屏幕追踪，否则可能跳过遮挡物
  • 使用 HZB 追踪快速准确地跳过空白空间，避免逐像素测试

我们用来避免这种错误自阴影的主要方法是使用屏幕空间光线追踪。由于屏幕光线是针对光栅几何体深度缓冲追踪的，我们可以依靠它们离开表面而不会错误地与代理几何体相交。然后我们可以基于屏幕追踪到达的距离来偏移世界追踪的原点，类似于图表所示，这避免了大多数自阴影问题。当然另一个好处是我们可以获得 BVH 中未表示细节的接触阴影。然而，不同于典型的接触阴影（通常可以用少量采样和短光线长度来完成），我们需要屏幕追踪是像素精确的。否则，我们可能会跳过遮挡物，而且光线长度是在世界空间定义的，这意味着在某些情况下我们需要追踪光线穿过整个屏幕，用固定步进太昂贵了。所以为了解决这个问题，我们依赖 HZB 追踪来快速但准确地跳过空白空间，而不用测试光线沿途的每个像素。我们希望尽可能避免典型的屏幕空间伪影。所以我们默认假设非常保守的低表面厚度。这意味着在大多数情况下，当光线穿过表面后面时，我们会回退到硬件光线追踪，而不是假设存在交点。

So the main method that we use to avoid this incorrect self shadowing is to use screen space ray tracing. Since the screen rays are traced against the raster geometry depth buffer, we can rely on them to move away from surfaces without incorrectly intersecting the proxy geometry. And we can then offset the origin of the world trace based on how far the screen trace got, similar to what the diagram shows, which avoids most of the self-shadowing issues. And of course another benefit is that we get contact shadows with detail that is not represented in the BVHs. However, unlike typical contact shadows where we can usually get away with a small number of taps and short ray length, we need our screen traces to be pixel accurate. Otherwise, we might skip over occluders and the ray length is defined in world space which means that in some cases we need to trace the rays all the way across the screen which is too expensive to do with fixed stepping. So to address this we rely on HZB tracing to be able to quickly but accurately skip empty space without testing against every pixel along the ray. We want to avoid typical screen space artifacts as much as possible. So we assume a very conservative low surface thickness by default. Meaning that in most cases we fall back to hardware ray tracing when rays go behind surfaces instead of assuming that there was an intersection.

另一个问题是长屏幕追踪由于深度缓冲混叠会导致明显的伪影。所以在实践中我们限制光线长度以避免这些问题。针对深度缓冲追踪可能导致自己的自阴影问题。我们通过结合点采样和双线性采样深度来避免。我们还使用模板位追踪哪些实例在光线追踪中有表示。如果光线穿过这些像素之一的后面，我们增加估计的厚度以从这些实例获得更多接触阴影。

Another issue is that long screen traces cause noticeable artifacts due to depth buffer aliasing. So in practice we limit the length of the ray to avoid those issues. And tracing against the depth buffer can cause its own self-shadowing issues. Which we avoid by combining both point and bilinear sample depth. We also track whether instances are represented in ray tracing using a stencil bit. And if the ray goes behind one of those pixels, we increase the estimated thickness to get a bit more contact shadows from those instances.

20. Alpha 遮罩几何体处理

关键点:

  • 对于漫反射 GI 可以用技巧如基于 Alpha 遮罩收缩或剔除三角形来近似遮挡
  • 这些方法对直接阴影效果不好，理想情况需要固定功能 Alpha 遮罩
  • 美术可以用材质图定义 Alpha 遮罩，无法实际使用固定功能
  • 选项一：所有光线使用完整 any hit 评估（准确但无法使用内联光线追踪）
  • 选项二：先做轻量内联追踪，命中需要材质评估的实例时追踪启用 hit 评估的延续光线

现在让我们谈谈 Alpha 遮罩几何体。虽然对于漫反射 GI 我们通常可以用技巧来近似遮挡，比如在 BVH 构建期间基于 Alpha 遮罩收缩或剔除三角形，但这些方法对直接阴影效果不好。理想情况下，我们会支持某种固定功能 Alpha 遮罩，可以在使用内联光线追踪时直接评估。但由于美术能够使用材质图定义 Alpha 遮罩，这对我们来说不太实际。所以我们还有几个其他选项。我们可以使用完整 any hit 评估追踪所有光线，这给我们准确的结果。但另一方面，我们无法从内联光线追踪中受益。所以它在主机上增加了很多开销。第二种方法是先做通常的轻量内联追踪。如果我们命中一个需要材质评估的实例，我们追踪一条启用 hit 评估的延续光线。这种方法在需要的地方给我们准确性，但不会失去所有光线的内联光线追踪好处。

Now let's talk about alpha mask geometry. While for diffuse GI we can usually get away with tricks like shrinking or culling triangles during BVH build based on the alpha mask to cheap approximate occlusion, those methods don't work well for direct shadows. Ideally, we would support some sort of fixed function alpha masking that we could directly evaluate when using inline ray tracing. But since artists are able to define the alpha mask using material graphs, that's not really practical for us. So we're left with a few other options. We can trace all rays using full any hit evaluation which gives us accurate results. But on the other hand, we can't benefit from inline ray tracing. So it adds a lot of overhead on consoles. The second approach is to do the usual lightweight inline trace first. And if we hit an instance that needs material evaluation, we trace a continuation ray with hit evaluation enabled. This approach gives us accuracy where needed but without losing the inline ray tracing benefits for all rays.

However, in practice, this causes a few noticeable visual artifacts. First of all, the underlying structure of the frustum grid is quite noticeable, especially when the camera moves. This sort of issue can also happen with world space grid, but at least in that case it's stable since it's not camera dependent. And we also need to use temporal filtering, but reprojection causes noticeable issues that we cannot completely avoid.

另一个选项是使用混合方案，只在两个体积之间共享采样和追踪。我们基于 frustum 位置运行探针的采样逻辑，因为它们更密集，这意味着我们可以在邻近探针之间共享可见性数据而不影响引导效果。然后我们追踪这些样本。最后，我们运行两个着色 pass，每个体积一个，每个体积随机从最近的采样探针收集样本。

Another option is to use a hybrid solution where only sampling and tracing are shared between the two volumes. We run sampling logic for probes based on the frustum positions since they're denser, which means that we can share visibility data between neighbor probes without hurting guiding effectiveness. We then run tracing for those samples. And finally, we run two shading passes, one for each volume, where each volume stochastically gathers samples from the closest sampling probes.

24. 半透明采样挑战

关键点:

  • 不透明表面80%能量来自一个光源的假设不适用于半透明
  • 半透明注入球谐，不知道哪些表面会使用每个体素着色
  • frustum 体素相对像素仍然很大，随机上采样可能导致不稳定或需要更宽滤波
  • 采样在统一体积中完成，必须同时考虑相位函数和半透明 BRDF，导致光源权重更均匀
  • 需要每体素着色更多样本，可以增加样本数（更昂贵）或扩展随机上采样从多个邻居收集样本（会模糊可见性项）

早些时候我们谈到不透明管线时，提到了通常80%的能量来自一个光源的假设。虽然对于不透明表面，我们可以访问着色时使用的法线和材质属性。所以在采样期间你可以用少量样本每像素。为半透明选择样本更具挑战性。首先我们将光源注入球谐，我们不知道哪些表面会提前使用每个体素着色。frustum 体素相对像素大小仍然相当大。所以从邻近体素随机上采样可能导致不稳定或需要更宽的滤波。由于采样在统一体积中完成，我们必须同时考虑相位函数和半透明 BRDF，这导致光源权重更均匀。这些因素的组合意味着我们最终必须每体素着色更多样本，比不透明表面通常需要的更多。我们可以通过增加每体素样本数量轻松做到这一点。但当然，这使管线的所有阶段都更昂贵。

或者，我们可以扩展着色期间的随机上采样，不是从单个邻居着色样本，而是可以从多个邻居收集、组合和着色样本。这避免了额外的采样和追踪开销，但也导致光照细节损失，因为它最终会模糊可见性项。最后，我们还应用时间和空间滤波来提高体积中的光照稳定性。

Earlier when we talked about the opaque pipeline, we mentioned the assumption that typically 80% of the energy comes from one light. While for opaque surfaces, we have access to the normal and material properties that we use during shading. During sampling we can get away with a few samples per pixel. Selecting samples for translucency is more challenging. First of all we're injecting the lights into spherical harmonics and we don't know which surfaces will be shaded using each voxel ahead of time. The frustum voxels are still quite large relative to pixel size. So stochastic upsampling from neighboring voxels can lead to instability or require wider filtering. And since sampling is done in a unified volume, we have to consider both the phase function and the translucent BRDF, which causes light weights to be more uniform. The combination of these factors means that we end up having to shade more samples per voxel than are usually required for opaque surfaces. We can do this easily by increasing the number of samples per voxel. But of course, this makes all stages of the pipeline more expensive. Alternatively, we can extend the stochastic upsampling that we do during shading and instead of shading samples from a single neighbor, we can gather, combine and shade samples from multiple neighbors. This avoids extra sampling and tracing overhead, but also results in a loss of lighting detail since it ends up blurring the visibility term. Finally, we also apply temporal and spatial filtering to improve lighting stability in the volumes.

25. 高质量半透明光照

关键点:

  • 玻璃等半透明需要更高质量光照包括高光，简单方法是对前层再次运行整个 Megalights 管线
  • 这通常太昂贵，如果玩家靠近表面可能使光照成本翻倍
  • 还需要支持多层着色，需要更可扩展的方式
  • 便宜选项：使用半透明体积光照，利用已有的球谐提取主导方向近似高光光照
  • 这种方法在简单情况下效果好，但只能支持一个高光高亮，且球谐光照必须非常稳定否则高光会明显抖动

一些半透明如玻璃需要更高质量的光照包括高光。一个简单的方法是认为前层最重要，通过再次运行整个 Megalights 管线来着色它以获得准确的光照。然而，这通常在实践中太昂贵，因为如果玩家靠得太近表面，我们很容易使光照的整体成本翻倍。我们还需要支持多层着色。所以我们需要以更可扩展的方式处理这个问题。一个便宜的选项是使用半透明体积来照亮表面。我们可以利用已有的球谐并提取主导方向来近似高光光照。这种方法在简单情况下效果不错，但正如你在这些截图中看到的，它只能支持一个高光高亮，并且需要球谐中的光照非常稳定，否则即使光源是静态的高光也会明显抖动。目前我们使用这种方法，但这是一个持续工作的领域，因为我们希望在这类半透明表面上支持更好的光照质量。

Some translucency such as glass requires higher quality lighting and including specular. A simple approach is to consider the front layer to be the most important and shade it by running the whole Megalights pipeline again so it gets accurate lighting. However, this is usually too expensive in practice since we can easily end up doubling the overall cost of lighting if the player gets too close to surfaces. We also need to support shading multiple layers. So we need to handle this in a more scalable way. One cheap option is to light the surfaces using the translucency volume. We can double down on the spherical harmonics that we already have and extract the dominant direction to approximate specular lighting. This approach can work well in simple cases but as you can see in these screenshots it can only support one specular highlight and requires lighting in the spherical harmonics to be very stable otherwise specular can noticeably jitter even when the lights are static. For now we are using this method but this is an area of ongoing work since we want to support better lighting quality on this type of translucent surfaces.

26. 性能数据与美术工作流

关键点:

  • PlayStation 5 上 1080p 渲染分辨率、每像素一个样本、禁用 async compute
  • 屏幕上超过900个光源，每像素约20-80个光源，总成本约5.5毫秒
  • 采样比着色花费更多时间（尽管以半分辨率运行），因为采样成本随光源数量扩展
  • 半透明着色几乎和不透明一样昂贵，因为需要每体素着色更多样本
  • 美术开始使用 Megalights 后很快就开始大量放置光源，使用程序化光源生成器沿样条自动放置光源

现在让我们看看所有这些在运行时性能方面是如何结合在一起的。这些数字来自 Megalights 演示在 PlayStation 5 上以 1080p 渲染分辨率、每像素一个样本、禁用 async compute 运行。屏幕上有超过900个光源，每像素约20到80个光源，总成本约5.5毫秒，这涵盖了直接光照的所有阴影和着色成本。一个有趣的事情是，不透明表面的采样比着色花费更多时间，尽管以半分辨率运行。这是因为采样成本随光源数量扩展，在这个场景中非常高，而且很多光源是矩形光，正如我之前提到的，采样非常昂贵且限制占用率。另一方面，着色有更固定的成本，因为它对每像素着色多少样本有上限，使其相对稳定，因为成本只真正受 tile 类型影响。另一件要注意的是半透明着色几乎和不透明一样昂贵，尽管屏幕上的探针比像素少得多。这是因为，正如我们之前讨论的，半透明需要我们每体素着色更多样本以提高稳定性和减少噪声。总的来说，一旦美术开始使用 Megalights，很快就会发现他们玩得多开心。看到他们在制作 Megalights 演示时进入新思维模式的过程真的很有趣。他们开始慢慢在这里那里放置光源，但很快就改变了，我们开始看到关卡中有更多光源。然后，正如你在这些截图中看到的，我们也开始看到矩形光的使用增加，在某个时候美术真的很习惯使用程序化光源生成器沿样条自动放置光源这样的工具。整个系统扩展性好得多，也更宽容。但内容优化如减少衰减范围、锥角或遮光板仍然有助于减少噪声和采样 pass 成本。

So let's now take a look at how all this comes together in terms of runtime performance. These numbers are from the Megalights demo running on a PlayStation 5 at 1080p render resolution with one sample per pixel and async compute disabled. There are over 900 lights on screen which result in around 20 to 80 lights per pixel and the total cost is about five and a half milliseconds and that covers all the shadowing and shading cost for direct lighting. One interesting thing to note is that sampling for opaque surfaces takes more time than shading despite running at half resolution. That's because sampling cost scales with the number of lights which is very high in this scene and a lot of those lights are rect lights which like I mentioned earlier are very expensive to sample and limit occupancy. On the other hand, shading has a more fixed cost since it has an upper bound on how many samples are shaded per pixel making it relatively stable since the cost is only really affected by the tile type. Another thing to notice is that the translucency shading is almost as expensive as opaque despite there being significantly fewer probes than there are pixels on the screen. That's because, as we discussed earlier, translucency requires us to shade more samples per voxel in order to improve stability and reduce noise. Overall, once artists start using Megalights, it quickly becomes clear how much fun they're having. It was really interesting to see the progression as they got into a new mindset while working on the Megalights demo. They started slowly putting lights here and there, but that quickly changed and we started to see many more lights in the level. Then, as you can see in these screenshots, we also started to see the usage of rect lights ramp up and at some point artists got really comfortable using tools like procedural light spawners to automatically place lights along splines.

27. 总结与未来工作

关键点:

  • Megalights 利用实时光线追踪在当前一代主机上评估直接光照
  • 质量限制：网格在光线追踪中的表示质量、大多数情况下每像素只有一个样本
  • 性能随每像素光源样本数和光线追踪场景复杂度扩展
  • 未来工作：使 Megalights 生产就绪、可扩展性问题、降噪和上采样（机器学习研究很有前景）
  • 主要挑战：硬件光线追踪中的网格表示，动态几何体仍是未解决问题

总结一下，Megalights 利用实时光线追踪即使在当前一代主机上也能评估直接光照。但当然，仍然有质量限制，比如网格在光线追踪中的表示有多好。在大多数情况下，我们限于每像素一个样本。

所以仔细的采样和降噪至关重要。这项技术的性能随每像素光源样本数和光线追踪场景复杂度扩展。

总的来说我们发现这在实践中是一个很好的权衡，光源数量不再是主要限制。在未来工作方面，我们仍在努力使 Megalights 生产就绪。有一堆优化、修复和缺失功能需要实现和改进。

可扩展性仍然是一个开放问题。一旦内容使用 Megalights 创作，在不需要光照美术大量工作的情况下减少光源数量变得具有挑战性。我们不想最终让美术必须手动维护多个光照设置。

最重要的领域之一是降噪和上采样。目前，Megalights 运行自己的降噪，然后输出由 TSR 进一步处理。

有大量使用机器学习的新研究在这个领域显示出非常有前景的结果。我们认为这里有机会统一并总体上更好地集成这些 pass 以降低成本和提高最终图像质量。

未来的主要挑战是硬件光线追踪中的网格表示。到目前为止，我们一直能够使用低多边形代理和其他捷径，因为漫反射 GI 和粗糙反射相当宽容。

但直接光照的阴影很容易暴露网格的底层表示。动态几何体仍然是一个未解决的问题，它很容易超出内存和性能预算，使得目前无法准确表示大量动画实例。虽然我们开始看到新的光线追踪 API 扩展将使 Nanite 网格的更高效表示成为可能，但几何复杂度不断增长，还有新类型的内容在光线追踪中表示更具挑战性，需要解决。

To wrap things up, Megalights leverages real-time ray tracing to evaluate direct lighting even on current gen consoles. But of course, there are still quality limitations such as how well meshes are represented in ray tracing. And in most cases, we're limited to one sample per pixel. So careful sampling and denoising are critical. The performance of this technique scales with number of light samples per pixel and the ray tracing scene complexity. And overall we have found that this is a good trade-off in practice and that light counts aren't a major limitation anymore. In terms of future work, we are still working towards making Megalights production ready. There's a bunch of optimizations, fixes and missing features that we need to implement and improve. Scalability is still an open problem. Once content is authored using Megalights, it becomes challenging to reduce light count without requiring a lot of work from lighting artists. And we don't want to end up in a situation where artists have to maintain multiple lighting setups manually. One of the most important areas is denoising and upsampling. At the moment, Megalights runs its own denoising and then the output is further processed by TSR. There's a ton of new research using machine learning that shows very promising results in this area. And we think that there's opportunity here to unify and in general better integrate these passes to reduce cost and improve final image quality. And the main challenge for the future is mesh representation in hardware ray tracing. Until now, we've been sort of able to get away with low poly proxies and other shortcuts since diffuse GI and rough reflections are quite forgiving. But shadows for direct lighting can easily expose the underlying representation of the meshes. Dynamic geometry is still very much an unsolved problem and it can easily blow memory and performance budgets making it currently impossible to accurately represent large numbers of animated instances. And while we are starting to see new extensions to ray tracing APIs that will enable more efficient representation of Nanite meshes, geometry complexity is constantly growing and there are new types of content that are even more challenging to represent in ray tracing and will need to be addressed.

28. Q&A 环节

关键点:

  • 光源层次结构（light cuts）的问题是不考虑阴影项，被遮挡光源问题无法解决
  • 上采样失败判断：基于深度和法线加权每个像素，权重为零时无法上采样
  • 样本扭曲精度问题：每次扭曲损失一位精度，但由于只采样少量光源所以不会耗尽
  • 代理网格不匹配：屏幕追踪效果很好，美术倾向放置软阴影光源有助于隐藏不匹配
  • 集群加速结构可能有助于减少代理网格，但主机上目前不可用

这就是我们演讲的全部内容。我们要感谢所有帮助制作幻灯片的人、UE5 团队、光照美术、制作 Megalights 演示的美术们，以及 Natasha 组织这个课程。谢谢。

So that's it for our presentation. We would like to thank everyone that helped with the slides, the UE5 team, the lighting, the artists that worked on the Megalights demo, and Natasha for organizing this course. Thank you.

Q: 你们研究过多光源合并技术如 light cuts 吗？
A: 是的，我在开头提到过它们作为光源层次结构，本质上我们这里的主要问题是那些被遮挡的光源，它们对此帮助不大。

Q: Have you looked into many light merging techniques like light cuts?
A: Yes, I mentioned those in the beginning as those light hierarchies and essentially the main problem which we have here are those like occluded lights and they don't really help much with that.

Q: 如何确定给定帧的上采样是否失败然后回退到上一帧信息？
A: 当我们做上采样时，我们按深度和法线加权每个像素，如果这些权重为零，我们就无法上采样。比如说有一根很细的线或类似的东西。

Q: How do you determine if upscaling has failed for a given frame before you fall back to last frame's information?
A: When we are doing upscaling we weight each pixel by the depth and normal and if those weights are zero then we just cannot upscale. Let's say there's like a very thin wire or something like that.

Q: 从同一个蓝噪声样本进行多轮样本扭曲是否遇到精度问题？
A: 是的，这是个好问题。每次我们扭曲那个样本，我们都会损失一位精度，但我们实际上没有采样那么多光源。正如我在那之后的下一张幻灯片中谈到的，我们尝试采样少量光源，因为我们只采样上一帧可见的光源，我们也只从光源网格单元采样几个光源。所以总的来说我们不会耗尽那些位。

Q: Have you run into precision issues from multiple rounds of sample warping from the same blue noise sample?
A: Yes, that's a great question. Each time we warp that sample, we are losing one bit of precision, but we are not really sampling that many lights. As I talked about in the next slide after that, we try to sample like a small amount of lights because we only sample the lights which were visible last frame and we also only sample like a few lights from the light grid cell. So overall we don't run out of those bits.

Q: 只使用光线追踪检查光源遮挡应该需要高质量光线追踪几何体。它与动画 Nanite 网格配合得如何？
A: 在某些情况下我们确实支持动画代理网格，那会导致不匹配，屏幕追踪确实效果很好。我们注意到的另一件事是，当我们有 Megalights 时，美术最终会放置很多软光源或投射软阴影的光源，这确实有助于隐藏不匹配问题。最后，我们有虚拟阴影贴图路径用于主要光源或这确实是问题的情况。他们可以标记那些特定实例渲染到阴影贴图，这样它们就能获得完整准确的阴影表示。

Q: Using only ray tracing to check light occlusion should require high quality ray tracing geometry. How well does it work with animated Nanite meshes?
A: In some cases we do support animated proxy meshes that will cause mismatches and screen traces do tend to work very well. Another thing that we've noticed is when we have Megalights artists end up placing a lot of soft lights or lights casting soft shadows and that does help hide the mismatch issues. And finally, we have the virtual shadow map path for like hero lights or in situations where this is really a problem. They can mark those specific instances to be rendered into shadow maps so then they get the full accurate shadow representation.

Q: 有没有策略减少遮挡检测的延迟？是否应用任何滤波来隐藏那些情况下突然的亮度变化？
A: 是的，我们确实有这个遮挡滤波器，基本上就是一些额外的空间样本应用于没有累积足够历史的帧。总的来说延迟大多很好，因为这个着色置信度的东西修复了大多数问题。只有当真的有很多光源时才是问题。所以我们无法快速累积它们。

Q: Are there strategies to reduce latency of disocclusion detection? Is any filtering applied to hide sudden luminance changes in those cases?
A: Yes, we do have this disocclusion filter which is basically just like some extra spatial samples applied to frames which didn't accumulate enough history. And overall the latency is mostly good because of this shading confidence thing which fixes most of the stuff. And it's only a problem when there are really a lot of lights. So we are not able to accumulate them quickly.

Q: 能否用集群加速结构减少/消除代理网格？
A: 是的，这绝对是我们感兴趣的东西。目前在主机上不可能，所以我们真的做不了。但是，这绝对是我们会集成的东西。不清楚我们是否能完全摆脱代理网格。像曲面细分这样的东西，如果你见过 Nanite 植被，即使有新的光线追踪扩展，这也不是我们能表示的东西。但是，理想情况下我们能够摆脱所有代理网格和屏幕追踪，但你仍然还有很长的路要走。

Q: Could you reduce/get rid of proxy meshes with cluster acceleration structures?
A: Yeah, so yeah, this is definitely something that we're interested in. It's not currently possible on consoles, so we cannot really do it. But yeah, it's something where we'll definitely integrate. It's unclear if we can completely get rid of proxy meshes. Stuff like tessellation and if you've seen Nanite foliage is not really something that we can represent even with the new ray tracing extensions. But yeah, ideally we would be able to get rid of all proxy meshes and screen traces, but you're still far away.

Q: Megalights 与移动光源、快速移动相机（如驾驶）和动画网格配合得如何？
A: 这又取决于给定像素的光照有多复杂。如果例如只有一个主导光源或者两个，那么它们处理得相当好。但如果例如有20个光源需要多帧累积，那就真的很糟糕。所以很难回答这个问题。但基本上随机采样给你这个滑块，你可以在性能和质量以及那些时间问题之间滑动，这取决于你想怎么设置它。

Q: How well do Megalights work with moving lights, fast moving camera (e.g., driving) and animated meshes?
A: Yes. So again this depends on how complex is the lighting at a given pixel. If for example there's only one dominant light or maybe two then they handle it pretty well. But if there's for example like 20 lights which require multiple frames of accumulation then it's really bad. So it's hard to answer this question. But basically stochastic sampling gives you this slider where you can slide between performance and quality and those temporal issues and it depends you know how do you want to set it up.
